description:
Summarize the latest status checks and policy evaluations for a pull request.
- Surfaces pipeline and run identifiers so you can jump straight to the blocking validation.
- Pair with pipeline tools (e.g., get_pipeline_run, pipeline_timeline) to inspect failures in depth.

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

name: get_pull_request_checks
